title: Vatican archives ceremony with Bledsoe's photo

tellings.quote: Yeah, they had a ceremony. They put my picture in the picture of the pope on the outside of the archives and then they placed my photo between the books of Galileo and Capernicus.

plain: In 2017, a photograph taken by Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, was reportedly placed in the Vatican archives during a ceremony, set between books by Galileo and Copernicus, with his picture shown beside the Pope's outside the archives. Bledsoe tells Michels this second-hand, as he heard it from the religious studies scholar Diana Pasulka and a man named Timothy Taylor. To Bledsoe it means the Church took his experiences seriously enough to keep them alongside great figures of science.
